verdict.rationale: Baseten documents asynchronous inference (request ID returned quickly, completion via webhook/polling) explicitly for batch work and long documents, so the submission mechanism is real. However, the only documented pricing discount is for KV-cached input tokens, not for async/batch requests specifically — there is no evidence of a documented discount rate for async vs real-time inference pricing. missing for 10: a documented async/batch discount rate or pricing tier distinct from real-time pricing, first-party pricing page showing the discount percentage.
